about: W-73 contract: relpath -> Supabase Storage object key. Every character outside storage-api's VALID_OBJECT_KEY (supabase/storage src/storage/limits.ts @ 69bb550) becomes one _, per code point; / and the allowed characters are kept; no Unicode folding. Read by ingest/pull_files.test.mjs (storageKeyFor); db/tests/phase14_095_storage_key.sql carries the same cases array inline between $storage_keys$ tags (bb_file_storage_key), and pull_files.test.mjs checks that copy equals this one. Non-ASCII is written as \u escapes so NFC and NFD stay distinct.
